Remark
[Subsolution and supersolution terminology] ↗ thm:parabolic-weak-maximum-principle 1. ch7:7.1.4-rem-1\group Maximum Principles

Inequality (63) defines a subsolution, whose maximum lies on the parabolic boundary $\Gamma _T$; (64) defines a supersolution, whose minimum lies on $\Gamma _T$.
